_comment: Reviewed list of AUR packages that shipped malware, and process names left by that malware. Shipped with Vigil and never downloaded at run time. Each entry names its public source. A match means: find out where your copy came from; it does not prove your copy is the malicious one.

packages.name: acroread
packages.incident: 2018-07 orphaned-package takeover by xeactor: install script fetched and ran a remote script
